['Deichmann SE '].company_description: Deichmann SE is one of Europe's largest footwear retailers and is headquartered in Essen, Germany.

['Brose Fahrzeugteile SE & Co. KG '].company_description: Brose Fahrzeugteile GmbH & Co. KG is an automotive supplier headquartered in Coburg, Germany. The company develops and produces mechatronic components and systems for vehicle doors, seats, and body at 62 locations in 23 countries worldwide. It has over 80 car manufacturers and other automotive suppliers as customers and employs more than 26,000 people globally. The company generated sales of €6.3 billion in fiscal 2018.
